description: This file defines configuration options and related classes for integrating Azure Event Hubs with Orleans streaming, including connection setup, validation, and pressure monitoring configurations.

classes.name: EventHubOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration settings for connecting to and managing Azure Event Hubs within Orleans, including connection setup methods and validation.

classes.name: EventHubOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the correctness of EventHubOptions configuration, ensuring necessary properties are set.

classes.name: StreamCheckpointerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration of stream checkpointing services within Orleans.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverOptions
classes.description: Provides optional settings for Event Hub receivers, such as prefetch count and start position.

classes.name: EventHubStreamCachePressureOptions
classes.description: Configures pressure monitoring parameters for Event Hub stream caching, including thresholds and window sizes.

methods.name: ConfigureEventHubConnection
methods.description: Multiple overloads to configure EventHub connection using connection string, namespace, credentials, connection object, or delegate.

methods.name: ValidateValues
methods.description: Checks that event hub name and consumer group are non-empty strings.
